rationale: Label-horizon sweep at winning geometry (K_SL=3.5/K_TP=3.0, LT=0.7/N=1): lp=6 candles (6h@1h). Discovered 2026-07-13 that the reported Lever1 'winner' (avg PF 0.694) was actually run at lp=12, not lp=6 as reported - live config runs lp=6 and shows time_limit_exit dominating (67% of trades, 40% WR) since K_SL=3.5 went live 2026-07-08. Testing whether extending the horizon lets winners reach the 90%+ WR exit_signal alpha instead of timing out as a coin flip.
